observations.body: Under military pressure Saul offers the burnt offering; Samuel arrives, questions him, and announces that his kingdom will not continue.
observations.label: Saul offers before Samuel arrives

observations.body: The passage presents delay, scattering troops, fear, royal action, rebuke, and lost dynasty as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: delay, scattering troops, fear, royal action, rebuke, and lost dynasty

observations.body: The passage places unauthorized royal action beside delay, scattering troops, fear, royal action, rebuke, and lost dynasty.
observations.label: unauthorized royal action

payload.posture: Read 1 Samuel 13:8–15 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: Saul’s stated pressure explains his choice but does not turn it into obedience
